data.description:
From the guardrail audit (PQ-28, PR #49, docs/audit/2026-10-guardrail-audit.md), audit tree 0c7d60a.

**GAP-5** (G-2, Minor, new): Scheduling does not refuse a stale pin
- Evidence: verify.is_stale (verify.py:507) has no caller; SPEC 7.2
- What would close it: Call is_stale in schedule.refusal for non-legacy records

**GAP-6** (G-2, Minor, new (CONTRACT NOTE 1)): A self-consistent hand edit to a verified record is undetectable
- Evidence: verify.py:592-596; M2c accepted by check_provenance
- What would close it: Contract: a digest or recording id binding the record to its run

**GAP-7** (G-2, Minor, new): The MVP deck trusts verified.json's answer with no provenance and no test
- Evidence: mvp/tools/build_deck.py:241,266; mvp/tools/verify.py:166-216
- What would close it: A provenance check in build_deck, or retire the MVP deck once the room runs

Held: an audit's findings are the client's to release. Read the gap's section in the audit report before planning; re-verify on the current main.

PLAN PQ-58 /Users/michellerojas/rust-nyc-pop-quiz/.lattice/plans/task_01M461K1EZJE7SWYCVEMC37P2Z.md GAP-5: refusal gains a keyword-only pin (default reads pin.toml lazily), is_stale checked after in_reserve and before check_question, one new sentence, 4 unit tests + 1 CLI test; reserve_lines, bake and just demo do not check the pin (reported).

QUESTION PQ-58 (gap-6, gap-7): stale-bank check: none (q3 legacy, exempt; q4, q7, q8 match the pin). GAP-6 options A (digest: verify writes an unkeyed sha256 over the record and source; catches only an edit that forgot to recompute it, and q4/q7/q8 are refused until you re-verify them) / B (recording id + replay: proves record and recording agree, not that a toolchain made them; a real replay needs docker at schedule time) / C (contract note, no code). Recommended: C because the open path is your own uncommitted laptop edit, every committed edit already fails CI, and A would empty the reserve to q3 until a re-verify. Draft SPEC/EVALUATION wording for A and B is in the plan. GAP-7 options A (closed by retirement, no code) / B (delete mvp/tools) / C (check in build_deck). Recommended: A. Reply RESUME PQ-58 <gap-6 letter> <gap-7 letter>.

RULING PQ-58 from the client in panel 2026-11-06: GAP-6 B, recording id plus a true replay (re-running the sandbox), behind a feature flag; plan first and show the client before any code. GAP-7 A, closed by retirement, no code. Delegator is planning GAP-6 now and halts for the client's approval of the plan.

PLAN-GAP6 PQ-58 (plan section 'GAP-6 plan after the ruling'): recording file bank/recordings/<id>.json written by just verify, naming its record by sha256 (record format and room unchanged); schedule checks it when present; just schedule --replay re-runs the source in the sandbox and refuses any disagreement. Waiting on the client's approval of the plan and 4 decisions: flag form, where the id lives, missing recording, file clearance. No GAP-6 code until then. GAP-7 A recorded.

RULING PQ-58 GAP-6 plan, client in panel 2026-11-06: 'approve, 2a, 3deny untilk reverified 4 yes'. (1) not named; taken as the plan's --replay option on just schedule. (2) the id lives in bank/recordings/<id>.json (record format and room unchanged). (3) a non-legacy record with no recording is REFUSED until re-verified: q4, q7, q8 are refused by schedule until the client runs just verify on each; legacy q3 exempt, as with the stale-pin check. (4) clearance granted: runner.py, verify.py, bank/recordings/, bank/README.md, one RUNBOOK line; SPEC 3.2/7.2 and the EVALUATION AC-7 row with the plan's draft wording, approved with the plan.

RULING PQ-58 session 2, client in panel 2026-11-06: legacy q3 also refused without a recording; q3, q4, q7, q8 all refused until re-verified with just verify (reserve empty until then, accepted). Both GAP-6 parts kept (recordings + --replay). SPEC 3.2/7.2 and EVALUATION AC-7 wording approved; verbatim text in .claude/checkpoint-pq58.md 'Session 2 rulings'. Implementation resumes in a fresh session.

PROGRESS PQ-58 GAP-6 implemented: HEAD e689a17 (signed; 7dc6e3f code+tests, e689a17 docs in the approved wording), not pushed. just test rc 0 warm 28 s: pipeline 1274 passed 1 skipped, web 306, cargo ok. test-full not run locally (q8 real replay waits for CI). Deviations: recording check placed after check_question so existing refusals read as before; --replay ignores which supported host ran (platform unpinned). QUESTION PQ-58 (review.py): `popquiz review edit` re-verifies in a scratch bank and drops the recording, so an edited question is refused until `just verify` runs on it (fails closed). Clear pipeline/src/popquiz/review.py for a ~3-line copy of the recording into <bank>/recordings, or leave it and record it in DONE? Reply RESUME PQ-58 review-py yes|no. Next session: Codex review, validate, PR.

RULING PQ-58 review-py, client in panel 2026-11-06: "RESUME PQ-58 review-py yes". pipeline/src/popquiz/review.py is cleared for one change: _verify_into_bank copies the scratch recording into <bank>/recordings with the question (RED test first). Next session does it before the Codex review.
